reason: I do need something better than what we've got now that we're adding buses and contracts, but I'm not putting my bookings and driver records into a brand-new system nobody else is using yet. If it goes belly-up or falls over on a busy school excursion week, I'm the one cleaning up the mess.
objection: My drivers aren't tech people and they won't use another app, and with no other operators on it I've got no one to ask whether it actually works in a real depot.
would_change_my_mind: A free trial on a few of my buses, plus hearing from a couple of operators my size at the bus association meeting that their drivers actually use it.
